<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



First-run only: public, and refused with `409` once the server has any
account. Lists Famlin backups (`famlin-backup-<timestamp>.zip`, the
export format written by scheduled backups) in the backups volume and,
until Famlin 1.0.0, legacy scheduled-backup dumps
(`db/famlin-<timestamp>.dump`), newest first. A zip whose manifest
can't be read is listed with `valid: false`. Rate-limited to 30
requests per 15 minutes per IP.
